$about: persona.json: one person, everything about them, at the root of a persona package (a .persona.zip holding, beside it, every file it names in pictures/, audio/, avatars/). Each field below is written as the values it may take, then "—", then what it means; $values explains how values are written. A list shows one entry, standing for every entry. Keys beginning with $ are notes, never part of persona.json. Every field is written; their order does not matter. A reader ignores any field it does not know, and reads a value it does not know as $values says; specVersion changes whenever a field or a value is added, or one changes meaning. Nothing in the file belongs to any one app: an app keeps its own data about a persona (how it lays people out, what it has built from the photos, its settings) apart from it. A persona's life is told on a timeline: profiles (who they were), slices (the chapters of their life), health periods and events, and the people, places, schools, property, pets and jobs with periods of their own. A null end date means ongoing; for someone deceased, it runs until their death. Any date may be only roughly remembered: beside each date is a field named for it with Approximate added (startDateApproximate beside startDate) that says so, and the date is then the best guess at the day. The people reach as far back as a family tree does: anyone may be born from 1000-01-01 on, someone known to have died on a day nobody recorded is deceased with no deathDate, and the pronouns each went by are on their periods.

$values.a|b|c: one of the values listed, exactly as written. The lists grow, so a reader reads a value it does not know as other where the list has other, as unspecified where it has that, or as null where the field may be null; where none of these is among its values, the field says what. In a list of values, one it does not know is left out
$values.<timestamp>: a moment in time, ISO 8601 in UTC (2026-02-01T00:00:00.000Z)
$values.<id>: 1 to 64 characters naming the item, unique among the file's items of its kind; other fields refer to it by this
$values.<profile id>: the id of one of the file's profiles
$values.<relationship id>: the id of one of the file's relationships
$values.<group id>: the id of one of the file's relationshipGroups
$values.<place id>: the id of one of the file's places
$values.<slice id>: the id of one of the file's slices
$values.<sub-event id>: the id of one of the event's subEvents
$values.<0-100>: a number from 0 (lowest) to 100 (highest); 50 is the middle of the scale
$values.<#rrggbb>: a color: # and six hexadecimal digits
$values.<picture file>: the plain name (no folder, up to 200 characters, not starting with a dot) of a file in the package's pictures/ folder: .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp
$values.<audio file>: the plain name (no folder, up to 200 characters, not starting with a dot) of a file in the package's audio/ folder: .mp3, .wav, .webm, .ogg, .m4a
$values.<avatar file>: the plain name (no folder, up to 200 characters, not starting with a dot) of a file in the package's avatars/ folder: .glb (a glTF binary: rigged for a person's avatar, a plain textured mesh for a pet)

specVersion: 0.4 — the version of the format the file follows
id: <uuid> — this persona's own id; a person in another persona's file stands for this persona by naming it as their personaId
birthDate: <date> — the day the persona was born, 1000-01-01 or later
birthDateApproximate: true|false — true when the birth date is only approximate, a best guess by someone who does not remember the day; false when it is known
deathDate: <date>|null — the day the persona died; null while living, and for a persona who died on a day nobody recorded (deceased)
deathDateApproximate: true|false — true when the death date is only approximate, a best guess by someone who does not remember the day; false when it is known, and while it is null
deceased: true|false — whether the persona has died: true when they have died, with or without a deathDate; false while living. A persona deceased with no deathDate is taken to have lived to 80, or to the latest end date of their profiles, slices and health periods if that is later (a null end date runs until the death, so does not count)

tendencies.$about: The persona's core tendencies, each on a scale of 0 to 100. Profiles and slices may change them for a while (tendencyOverrides).
tendencies.attentiveness: <0-100>|null — focus on the task and its details: high stays on them and makes fewer mistakes, but is slower; low is quicker but less focused, and slips more; null until set
tendencies.extraversion: <0-100>|null — openness with inner thoughts: high shares them, and readily connects them to other people; low keeps them close; null until set
tendencies.agreeableness: <0-100>|null — willingness to go along: high avoids arguments, agrees where it has no set view, and keeps quiet rather than lie; low argues readily, and will lie where the persona would; null until set
tendencies.neuroticism: <0-100>|null — anxiety: high is anxious and guarded, and quick to see risk in what is asked; low is calm and open, and little worried about what could go wrong; null until set
tendencies.ambition: <0-100>|null — drive: high is curious about ideas with potential, even ones it disagrees with, and self-directed; low accepts the status quo, and leans on others; null until set
tendencies.emotionality: <0-100>|null — how the persona thinks and speaks: high through feeling, low through logic; null until set

profiles.$about: Who the persona was for a stretch of life: their name, look and voice, languages, orientation, beliefs and tastes. A new profile begins when one of these changed for good (a new name on marrying, a transition). On any day the profile in effect is the latest to have begun.
profiles.startDate: <date> — the first day of this profile
profiles.startDateApproximate: true|false — true when the first day is only approximate, a best guess by someone who does not remember the day; false when it is known
profiles.endDate: <date>|null — the last day of this profile; null while it goes on
profiles.endDateApproximate: true|false — true when the last day is only approximate, a best guess by someone who does not remember the day; false when it is known, and while it goes on
profiles.transitionBefore: <long text> — the change that led into this profile: a graduation, coming out, a diagnosis, and the questioning or upheaval around it; empty when there was none
profiles.label: <text> — what the profile is called on the timeline ("As Michael", "After the move")
profiles.primaryName: <text> — the persona's full name during this profile
profiles.description: <long text> — who the persona was during this profile
